items.title: Penha (SC) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #PRI 14
items.en_title: Penha (SC) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #PRI 14
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Penha (SC) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 348,076; proposals close Nov 24, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
